name: @stapel/tokens-antd
description: Token bridge (§68 neutral colour-role dictionary; frontend-guidelines §2.4, §38 T3): projects @stapel/tokens' roles (surface, brand, text-muted, success-bg, ...) onto an Ant Design ConfigProvider theme. `toAntdTheme(mode)` -> theme.token; `toAntdThemeConfig(mode)` -> the full ThemeConfig (algorithm + token). Pure functions reading the same `colors` object as @stapel/tokens-mui, so they cannot diverge. The root export is not components; the `/skin` subpath is the shared skin substrate every antd default skin inherits -- SkinTheme + useThemeMode (self-theming from the live data-theme, 44px phone controls), SkinDialog + SkinConfirm (a dialog is a bottom sheet on a phone), SkinCarousel (a swipeable strip is native scroll-snap with a peek, not a gesture layer), ErrorAlert / EmptyState / LoadBoundary / LoadList (the designed state arms), GatedControl / GatedButton (a blocked control's reason as visible text), PaneGate (one refusal per pane), Pane / Page (the measure), StatusTag, RowActions, ListRow / CardHeader, DataTable (table or cards by element width), useElementWidth (the fleet's one element-width measurement), ChoiceChips (a short closed list is chips a thumb can hit, not a dropdown), SkinPickerSheet (a long list is picked in a bottom sheet with search -- grouped recents, a multi footer that carries its count, a stale list that is never tappable), SkinNumberField (numeric keypad, unit as postfix, min/max as hints -- never a silent clamp), CountedInput (a live code-point counter, monospace for codes, paste normalization). SkinProvider + SkinButton/SkinInput -- the component registry (restyle layer 2): a host swaps Button/Input/Dialog ANATOMY once and every substrate render follows; no provider = byte-identical antd defaults.

size-limit.name: root -- the pure token bridge (no components, no React)
skin subpath -- the shared skin substrate (theme, dialog, confirm, carousel, permission, states, gate, pane, row, table, chips, picker sheet, number field, counted input)
